cases.title: Enable interactive elements on valid Bill Amount entry
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid numeric value greater than zero in the 'Bill Amount' input field enables the tip buttons, custom tip input, and number of people input, removing disabled and gray-input classes.

cases.title: Disable interactive elements on invalid or empty Bill Amount entry
cases.description: Verify that entering a non-numeric, zero, negative, or empty value in the 'Bill Amount' input field keeps or sets the elements to disabled and applies the 'disabled' class to the tip container and 'gray-input' class to inputs.

cases.title: Select predefined tip percentage and clear custom tip
cases.description: Verify that clicking a predefined tip button updates the selected tip percentage, adds the 'selected' class to the clicked button while removing it from others, clears the custom tip input, and updates 'Generate Bill' button state based on the number of people.

cases.title: Predefined tip button has no effect when Bill Amount is empty
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a predefined tip button does nothing when the 'Bill Amount' field is empty because the tip container remains disabled.

cases.title: Enter valid custom tip percentage and deselect predefined buttons
cases.description: Verify that entering a positive number in the 'Custom Tip' input updates the tip percentage, clears any selected predefined tip buttons, and updates the 'Generate Bill' button state.

cases.title: Handle invalid custom tip input values
cases.description: Verify that entering negative, non-numeric, or empty values in the 'Custom Tip' input does not update the tip percentage, keeps predefined tip buttons deselected, and leaves the 'Generate Bill' button disabled.

cases.title: Generate Bill button enablement conditions
cases.description: Verify that the 'Generate Bill' button is disabled by default and only enabled when both a valid non-zero number of people and a tip percentage (predefined or custom) are provided.

cases.title: Calculate bill outputs and enable Reset button
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'Generate Bill' correctly computes and displays the tip amount, total bill, and per-person bill for predefined tips, custom tips, and high percentages, and enables the 'Reset' button.

cases.title: Reset button clears all inputs, outputs, and states
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Reset' button clears all input and output fields, resets the tip percentage to 0, removes 'selected' classes, and disables both the 'Generate Bill' and 'Reset' buttons.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and properly account for the specified risk areas and states.
All requirements and cases are well-structured, clear, and fully testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behaviors include enabling 'Select Tip' buttons, 'Custom Tip' input, and 'Number of People' input when 'Bill Amount' is valid and > 0. Normal path: valid numeric > 0 enables elements. Abnormal paths: non-numeric, zero, negative, or empty input disables elements, adds 'disabled' class to 'tip-container', and 'gray-input' class to inputs. Boundary: 0 is invalid. R-2: Testable behaviors include updating tip percentage, adding 'selected' class to clicked tip button, removing 'selected' from others, clearing 'Custom Tip' input, and evaluating 'Generate Bill' enablement based on 'Number of People' >= 1. Normal path: clicking tip button with valid bill and valid people. Abnormal path: clicking when 'Bill Amount' is empty does nothing. R-3: Testable behaviors include validating positive numbers in 'Custom Tip', updating tip percentage, removing 'selected' from predefined buttons, and updating 'Generate Bill' state. Normal path: entering positive custom tip. Abnormal paths: negative numbers, zero, non-numeric, or empty input. Boundary: switching from predefined to custom tip clears predefined selection. R-4: Testable behaviors include enabling 'Generate Bill' only when 'Number of People' is valid non-zero and a tip percentage (predefined or custom) is selected/entered. Normal path: both conditions met. Abnormal paths: missing tip or invalid/zero people. Default: button disabled by default. R-5: Testable behaviors include calculation of tip amount, total bill, and per-person bill, and enabling 'Reset' button. Normal paths: predefined tips, custom tips, high percentages. Abnormal path: generate bill clicked with invalid/missing inputs. R-6: Testable behaviors include clearing all input/output fields, resetting tip percentage to 0, removing 'selected' classes, and disabling 'Generate Bill' and 'Reset' buttons upon clicking 'Reset'.
